stories.author: Judd Legum
stories.title: UPDATE: After the Mamdani 9/11 smear, a cover-up
stories.text: As Popular Information first reported last week, a New York Post headline falsely declared on its July 26 cover: “Thousands of 9/11 families demand Mamdani be banned from 25th-Anniversary.” Reporter Rich Calder reported in the New York Post print edition, which has a circulation of about 120,000, that the petition “has collected 3,515 signatures in a little over a week, most from victims’ family members.” This was false, according to the version of the story that was posted online. That article claimed that the petition “has collected over 1,100 signatures in a little over a week, including from at least 300 victims’ families .” A Popular Information interview with petition organizer Giovanni Galante on July 27 revealed that the lower number was also unsubstantiated. Galante admitted that he did not maintain a list of victims’ families who signed the petition, and the 300 figure was simply an estimate of how he believed the petition spread. “We don’t have a list,” Galante said. “If you know 10 people and they give it to 10 more people they know that lost. stories.title: Haley Stevens’ New Campaign Ad Features Anti-LGBTQ Pastor
stories.text: With just days left before the Democratic primary election in the closely watched Michigan Senate race, Senate hopeful Rep. Haley Stevens released an eleventh-hour campaign advertisement featuring a pastor with a history of delivering anti-LGBTQ sermons and sharing Islamophobic posts on social media. Several scenes in the ad , paid for by Stevens’ campaign, show Bishop Christopher Martin of the Flint-based Cathedral of Faith Ministries Church of God in Christ. Martin has sparked controversy in the past for comments he made about the firing of a pastor who was allegedly gay, which were considered homophobic . “We cannot have perversion over the people,” said Martin in a video that surfaced in 2022, referring to homosexuality. “We are trying to love them out of what they’re in.” Create a FREE account, or log in.
